title: Head Position After Movement
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration on input word $y$, and let $i$ be an input-head position. If the head of $d$ is at $i$, then after moving the head by any sign $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$ with boundary clamping, the head is at the correspondingly moved position of $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $d$ on a fixed input word $y$
An input-head position $i$ among the $|y|+2$ positions
The head of $d$ is at position $i$
